subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the existing prompt-send policy of dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization?
rationale: The code fix is coherent, but the permanent behavior decides whether aborted tool-call context is omitted or represented another way in retained session summaries.

options.title: Accept drop-policy repair
options.body: Use the same drop policy already used by prompt-send repair paths so compaction cannot retain orphaned aborted tool calls.

options.title: Require synthesized recovery
options.body: Ask the author to preserve aborted context through a synthetic or annotated recovery shape before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it in favor of a broader session-repair policy covering compaction, replay, and provider adapters together.

recommendation.title: Accept drop-policy repair
recommendation.body: Use the same drop policy already used by prompt-send repair paths so compaction cannot retain orphaned aborted tool calls.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across the shared transcript-repair helper and compaction planning paths touched by this policy choice.
